title: Ambient facts: ℝ^P is a C² submanifold of itself, and the calculus of the dilations η_{a,s} for sets and rescaled measures (parent conventions and (F3))
statement: (1) For every P ∈ ℕ, ℝ^P = Euclid P is an embedded C² P-dimensional submanifold of itself (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 P univ). For P, n ∈ ℕ, a measure ν on ℝ^P, points a, y, c, w ∈ ℝ^P, reals s, t > 0 and ρ ∈ ℝ, write η_{a,s} := dilation a s (η_{a,s}(v) = s^{−1}(v − a)) and ν^{a,s} := ofReal(s^{−n})•ν.map(η_{a,s}). Then: (2) ν^{a,s}(A) = ofReal(s^{−n})·ν(η_{a,s}^{−1}(A)) for every Borel A; (3) η_{a,s}^{−1}(B_ρ(w)) = B_{sρ}(a + s·w); (4) η_{a,s}(B_ρ(c)) = B_{ρ/s}(η_{a,s}(c)); (5) η_{a,s}(ℝ^P) = ℝ^P, and η_{a,s}(A) is open for every open A; (6) η_{y,t}(η_{a,s}(A)) = η_{a+s·y, s·t}(A) for every set A; (7) (ν^{a,s})^{y,t} = ν^{a+s·y, s·t}; (8) ofReal(1^{−n})•ν.map(η_{0,1}) = ν and η_{0,1}(A) = A for every set A; (9) ofReal(s^{−n})•(ν⌞B).map(η_{a,s}) = (ν^{a,s})⌞η_{a,s}(B) for every Borel B.
